title: HDFC Multi Cap Fund - Key Information Memorandum (KIM) & SID

sections.content: In compliance with SEBI regulatory circular SEBI/HO/IMD/DF3/CIR/P/2020/172, a Multi Cap fund must maintain a minimum 25% allocation in Large Cap companies, a minimum 25% allocation in Mid Cap companies, and a minimum 25% allocation in Small Cap companies at all times. The remaining 25% is allocated tactically based on market opportunities.
Minimum investment is ₹100 for lumpsum and ₹100 for monthly SIP. The fund offers Direct and Regular plans with Growth and IDCW options. There is zero lock-in.
